Questions.content: What is the definition of a majority element in this context, and can you ensure that the function handles edge cases, such as an empty array or an array with all elements being the same?

What is the expected behavior of the function when the majority element appears exactly half the number of times as the array length? For example, in the array [1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3], should `is_majority([1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3], 7, 3)` return True or False?

What is the expected behavior of the function when the array has multiple majority elements? For example, in the array [1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3], should `is_majority([1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3], 7, 1)` return True or False if 1 and 3 are both majority elements?
